messages:
zara: Postmortem follow-up: recurring issue where feature flags race to wide rollout and the canary auto-rollback either misses the signal or rolls back too late. Need owners + short, testable fixes.

mike: I can take the flag-create guardrail. Proposal: require max_audience_pct for all prod flags and default to 1%. Also add a CLI confirmation when >1%. Will open a small PR today.

elaine: Observability here was rough. I'll add a per-flag timeline view (errors, p95, token-drop) and a composite alert that fires when multiple signals correlate. ETA: 4 business days.

tom: I'll harden the rollback controller. Ideas: two-window confirmation (30s + 3m), hysteresis to avoid flapping, and a short cooldown after rollback to prevent thrash. Will draft a spec PR by EOW.

ops-bot: Incident ticket: INC-2026-338 created and linked to this thread. Watchers: @zara @elaine.

zara: Action tracker entries I'm setting now:
- Mike: flag-create API + CLI guard (due 2026-04-04)
- Elaine: dashboards + composite alert + runbook (due 2026-04-01)
- Tom: rollback controller hysteresis + tests (due 2026-04-07)

mike: Small note: make the flag API validation fail-fast in staging so teams can't test in prod without limits.

elaine: Also asking QA to author a small canary prompt set that runs on every canary deployment so we have a deterministic smoke check.

tom: Suggest simple rollback rule to start:
```
if (error_rate_1m > 0.5%) && (p95_tokens_3m > 850ms) -> rollback
```
plus 90s cooldown, then require 2-min confirmation.

zara: Also adding a policy: flags targeting >5% require secondary approver from eng-sre until these measures are in place.

mike: PR up: adds required max_audience_pct field and CLI prompt. Tests included.

elaine: I'll pump up trace sampling for canary traffic when a flag is active to help triage.

ops-bot: Deploy started: rollout-controller PR #910 by tom. CI running.

zara: Scheduling a 20m sync tomorrow 09:00 to review the PRs and signoffs. If unable to attend, post reviews on PRs and update the tracker.

mike: noted

elaine: will review PRs

tom: thanks everyone
